entries.what: Borrero and Nelsen (2003) 'Results of a comprehensive monitoring program at Pratte's Reef': venue, year and pages (citation completion)
entries.where: https://www.researchgate.net/publication/293137985 ; WebSearch 2026-10-10 'Borrero Nelsen Pratte's Reef monitoring Surfing Reef Symposium 2003 proceedings'
entries.detail: The PDF supplied by Lior (07_scale/shapes/prattes-reef-el-segundo/src/) prints neither venue nor year; the search found no catalogue entry, so '3rd International Surfing Reef Symposium, Raglan 2003' is believed but not confirmed. ResearchGate returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch (the figure pages too) before Lior supplied the PDF, so the page text could not be used to complete the citation.
entries.might_work: Lior: P13 / W10; authors J.C. Borrero and C. Nelsen (E1)

entries.what: Coastal Frontiers (2008-2010) removal outline mapping, Pratte's monitoring surveys 2000-2008, and Surfrider 'Pratte's Reef Decommissioning Assessment (2008)' / Coastal Frontiers (2009) 'Deconstruction Monitoring Report'
entries.where: https://www.coastalfrontiers.com/removal-of-prattes-reef ; surfrider.org news 'ASR removal in El Segundo, CA'; web searches
entries.detail: The Coastal Frontiers page gives the removal dates (phase 1 fall 2008, phase 2 2010), '14-ton bags' and says the outline was mapped before removal (unpublished), but no dimensions or map. No 'Decommissioning Assessment' or 'Deconstruction Monitoring Report' exists publicly (web searches, Surfrider news page, Beachapedia). So no as-built plan or crest survey exists in public: the drawn outline is the Skelly Phase I design layout and the only as-built number is ICCE 2010's 'outermost point 1.8 m below MLLW'.
entries.might_work: Lior: E2 (Surfrider LA / Coastal Frontiers Corp.: monitoring surveys and the 2008 removal mapping) and E1 (authors)

entries.what: Esri World Imagery (current and Wayback) as a view of the built reef
entries.detail: The reef was removed in 2008-2010 and the earliest Wayback release is 2014, so no frame can show it; the current Esri image (2026-01-09, registry img4) cannot show the structure either. The published coordinates plotted on it (Wikipedia 'Chevron Reef' 33.915123, -118.432624) fall about 280-290 m offshore in open water. Pre-2008 imagery is needed.
entries.might_work: Google Earth Pro historical imagery Oct 2000 - Oct 2010 (Lior: G1)

entries.what: Published coordinates of Pratte's Reef (Wikipedia 'Chevron Reef' 33.915123, -118.432624; '200 yards south of the Hyperion 1-mile outfall') as a position
entries.detail: Three published coordinates differ by 313 m and none fits the primary sources: the Wikipedia point lies in open water about 280-290 m offshore of the dry-sand edge. The model position (33.92058, -118.43335, +-150 m) was instead read from the survey window of Fig 9 in Borrero and Nelsen (2003). The Wikipedia page itself gives no plan view.
entries.might_work: Google Earth Pro history (Lior: G1) and the authors (E1) for a fixed position

entries.what: californiacoastline.org California Coastal Records Project oblique aerials 2002-2010 of Pratte's Reef
entries.detail: HTTP 403 to automated fetch, so the 2002-2010 oblique aerials (taken while the reef was in place) could not be used; none would give a scaled plan anyway, but they could show the bag layout.

entries.what: Surfline 'SANDBAGGED' (Fontaine 2008, 'After years of unspectacular closeouts Pratte's Reef is removed', card R7)

The card research (2026-09-24) recorded it as read through the browser pane, so the runs disagree. Its '8 feet deep at zero tide' quote is carried only as the upper bound of the crest-depth uncertainty (not used otherwise). A Surfline removal photo URL also gave 403 via S3.

entries.detail: HTTP 403 on both; inaccessible and not cited anywhere in the dossier. Title not recorded in the notes. It might hold post-removal monitoring or the as-built layout.

entries.what: Text-only web pages on Pratte's Reef: Wikipedia 'Chevron Reef', Beachapedia 'Pratte's Reef', Coastal Frontiers removal page, Surfrider removal news, CEQAnet 1997121007
entries.detail: All carry only dates and counts (110 bags fall 2000, +90 spring 2001, removal 2008-2010) with no layout figure; CEQAnet attachments are gone. These facts are card references; the plan-view part failed. Beachapedia also needed the browser pane (HTTP 403 to WebFetch).

entries.what: ICCE 2010 Borrero paper (pdfs.semanticscholar.org 8672e1bb...) and Nelsen (2012) UCLA dissertation: plan view or layout of Pratte's Reef
entries.detail: ICCE 2010 gives text only for Pratte's (110 geocontainers, 7.9 m3 maximum, 80-90 % filled, outermost point 1.8 m below MLLW after install, April 2001 +90 bags and crest within 1 m of MLLW) with no plan view; the '4 x 7 x 10 ft' bag size is not in its text. Nelsen 2012 has three passing mentions and no figure. Neither was saved.

entries.what: USGS / CSMP California State Waters bathymetry for Santa Monica Bay at 2 m resolution (0-10 m depth zone off El Segundo)
entries.where: USGS California State Waters Mapping Program; NOAA DEM already includes CSUMB multibeam
entries.detail: Not located at 2 m resolution for the 0-10 m zone; the NOAA DEM (which already includes CSUMB multibeam) was used for the seabed. Navionics contour counting at the revised reef position was also less reliable (4 of 12 depth labels reproduced; deeper labels off by 1-3 lines), so the DEM, not the chart, supplies the seabed.
entries.might_work: Lior: Navionics app readings (REQUESTS section 5, Pratte's B1-B7)

entries.what: Gemini's Pratte's sources: footprint 40 x 20 m (584-650 m2), 'CCC permit CDP 5-97-283 (1998)', Coastal Frontiers (2009) report, Surfline removal photo, surfrider.org policy URL, Bar and Drimer (2023) JMSE 11(2) 236
entries.where: Gemini reef_footprints.json and reference list (read-only); the named URLs
entries.by: agent: Pratte's tracer, verifier and re-verification (cloud)
entries.detail: '40 x 20 m VERIFIED' rests on Lior's image26 composite, whose single 200 m bar is not valid across its panels; the polygon is contradicted by the scaled Skelly drawing (58 x 29 m). The permit number 5-97-283 does not exist: the real record is Coastal Commission staff report W5a-10-1998 (E-98-15, a 1996 concept, wings 150 ft), which is the wrong design version for the built reef. The Coastal Frontiers 2009 report does not exist publicly. The Surfline photo URL gave 403, the surfrider.org policy URL 404, and Bar and Drimer (2023) names Pratte's once with no dimension (its real title differs from Gemini's). Gemini lead not confirmed; nothing used.
